preview_heading: Falcons meet Patriots in North Sound
preview: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons face St Kitts & Nevis Patriots in CPL 2026 Match 12 at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium. The match is scheduled for Thu 20 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
